description: From 1887 split into: Series A, Mathematical and physical sciences, and Series B, Biological sciences

Note on title verso: There was an interruption in the publication of the 'Philosophical Transactions' between Vol. 12 (1677) and Vol. 13 (1683). During this interval Dr. Robert Hooke published these seven numbers entitled 'Philosophical collections'
Vol. 178 (1887) - Vol. 182 (1891) Series A and B bound together and shelved at S.3 C [L]
From Vol. 183 (1892) see seperate records: Series A and Series B
